title: Introducing Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: We're excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, transitioning from beta to bring its powerful capabilities to all users.

title: Enhanced File Management and Display
summary: Our updated editor now empowers you with full control to effortlessly upload, manage, and tailor the display of all your embedded files.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: We've launched an exciting new public roadmap page, giving you a transparent look at our recent achievements, upcoming features, and future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, all with a fresh new look to streamline your workflow.

title: Elevated Editor Collaboration
summary: Experience enhanced teamwork with new editor features designed to make collaborating with others more seamless and intuitive.

title: Enhanced Sharing & Collaboration
summary: Discover and work together effortlessly on shared content, making collaboration more intuitive and powerful.

title: Global Language Support Has Arrived
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out full international language capabilities to connect users worldwide.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: We are proudly open-sourcing Noeko's codebase, giving you unprecedented control, transparency, and the opportunity to actively shape its future.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Exploration
summary: Explore your entire knowledge base with enhanced precision and collaboration features, leveraging powerful filters for tags, time, and shared content within the Constellation view.

title: Empower Your Knowledge Search with Smart Filters
summary: Unlock deeper insights with powerful new search filters and the ability to save personalized collections of your most relevant knowledge.

title: Enhanced Note Organization
summary: We're introducing flexible new ways to display your linked content, empowering you to effortlessly structure and interact with your notes.

title: Noeko: Unlock More with Premium Plans & Self-Hosted Flexibility
summary: We're launching new premium plans and a self-hosted option for Noeko, giving you greater control, enhanced features, and flexible deployment to power your work.

title: Discover Your Style: Revamped & New Themes
summary: Prepare for a stunning new look as we overhaul our current themes and launch an exciting array of fresh designs to personalize your experience.

title: Smarter, Time-Aware Greetings
summary: We're ensuring your homepage greetings always reflect the precise time of day, creating a more accurate and personalized welcome for you.

title: Quickly Unapply Tags in Bulk
summary: Effortlessly remove multiple items from a tag directly within the tag view, streamlining your content organization and saving you valuable time.

title: Expanded Content Sources
summary: Get ready to seamlessly integrate a wider variety of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to effortlessly expand your knowledge base.
